## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, and each body explains **why**
- [ ] Comments explain intent or a constraint, not mechanics
- [ ] Public functions are annotated; mypy passes
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR if behaviour changed
- [ ] Added an ADR in `docs/decisions/` if this decision is expensive to reverse
- [ ] **No fabricated numbers.** Any performance figure was measured, on hardware named
      next to it. Anything unmeasurable in my environment says "not measured on this
      hardware" instead of an estimate.

## If this touches models or benchmarks

- [ ] Licence and upstream source filled in on the `ModelSpec`
- [ ] A `BenchmarkCase` added to `benchmarks/run.py`
- [ ] Results JSON and the regenerated markdown committed together, with the hardware
      stated in the commit body

## If this touches the dataset generator

- [ ] `GENERATOR_VERSION` bumped and the manifest regenerated (not the fingerprint edited)
- [ ] Models retrained and benchmarks re-run, because the old accuracy numbers describe a
      dataset that no longer exists

## If this touches the schema

- [ ] Migration read line by line, not just autogenerated
- [ ] `downgrade()` works
- [ ] `docs/data-model.md` updated
